Beige Book - March 2023

Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

Summary of Economic Activity

Economic activity softened slightly.

Contacts in technology reported uncertainty and additional layoffs following bank failures.

Labor Markets

Employment levels were stable overall, though hiring became uncertain in tech.

Job cuts continued at large software employers, and workers worried about further layoffs.

Prices

Prices rose further, albeit at a slower pace.

Housing rents flattened.
